precedence.rule: First: every nested missing/unknown/null/wrong type/enum/empty string; before field access/lookup/CAS
Second: canonical full request digest; hashes provide integrity, not authority
Third: malformed workflow UUID
Fourth: publish/0 UUIDv5 mismatch
Fifth: context/new/source identity relation
Sixth: pre-existing target or invalid identity
Seventh: declared Unknown provider/catalog state
Eighth: declared Incomplete children
Ninth: frozen document fixture lookup unavailable
Tenth: caller record differs from separately frozen issuer fixture; context/binding checked thereafter
Trusted issuer context vs request context
Every body field vs explicit trusted issuer binding
Proof handles must resolve exact records
Ready receipt identity and trusted request digest
Ready path/prior/new/catalog/blob/root relationships
Native identity and stable marker location
Caller CAS outcome differs from frozen domain fixture
Unknown coherent CAS precedes delivery checks
Verified Ready + owner absent; precedes source ACK
Verified Ready + ACK absent
Only after all checks

notes: Frozen record equality intentionally fences all fields before downstream consistency checks; some detailed diagnostics are defensive and unreachable for internally consistent immutable fixture tables. No broad exception catch or success fallback.
